top_signals.title: ECB’s Zigman Sees ‘Rather Big Chance’ of December Rate Hike
top_signals.summary: The European Central Bank is likely to raise borrowing costs next month for the third time since the Iran war began, Governing Council member Ante Zigman said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Takaichi to skip U.N. climate summit in Turkey
top_signals.summary: It will mark the third consecutive year that a Japanese prime minister has not attended a U.N. climate summit.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
